svg.title: binarywang/WxJava: 16% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 16% of 43 recent commits in binarywang/WxJava carry a disclosed AI agent signature (43 commits, last 90 days). Devin 12%, GitHub Copilot 4.7%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
